We need to propose a retrosynthesis route with at least 3 reactions using templates 1914393, 1914394, 1914395 in this order.

We applied template 1914393 to target SMILES, got a tuple of precursors: ('COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nn[nH]c2N)c1', 'FC1CN(Cc2ccc(CCl)cc2)C1'). So first reaction splits target into two fragments: fragment A (aryl with methoxy and amide) and fragment B (fluoro-substituted piperidine attached to benzyl chloride? Actually SMILES: FC1CN(Cc2ccc(CCl)cc2)C1). Good.

Now we need to apply template 1914394 to each of those fragments? The order says use templates in this order, so second reaction should be applied to one of the precursors (maybe the first). We attempted applying 1914394 to fragment A, got no result. Maybe apply to fragment B. Let's try.
